reviews.t: Handy and helpful but not quite perfect
reviews.x: I purchased this item because I am a teacher and did not enjoy sucking in my mask when breathing and felt like my students sometimes had a hard time hearing me. For these things, it is AWESOME!!! I even gave one to my principal who also loved it for those same reasons! What I do not care for, however, is actually feeling it sit on my face. It is less hot than the fabric being directly on my face, but where my skin and the plastic connect, it does sometimes get sweaty and sometimes my mask will s

These mask brackets do make a difference and definitely keep the fabric masks from touching my mouth which definitely makes me less muffled when I'm talking! The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is that I can feel it more on my face and sometimes I feel like it gets a little steamy when I'm working.  I do wish it came down a little further instead of just under my lower lip but overall this is much more comfortable that the ezmasks that I had ordered online since they are a smidge wider. I think

reviews.t: Works to keep the mask out of my mouth
reviews.x: If I'm walking quickly or hiking, I have a hard time breathing with the mask on because as I inhale, the mask plasters itself against my mouth and nose. This bracket has really helped. I tried wearing it over the tip of my nose, but it's not long enough to work for me that way. I put the top of the mask just below my nose, and it works well and stays inside the mask. I can hike and walk quickly and still have both hands free because I don't need to hold the mask away from my mouth. I have bought

I liked rhe idea id these. The problem is its solved one problem while creating another. You don't suck your mask in when you talk but, you feel the insert on your face. I think it would be nice sewn in a mask. I work at a hospital and wear a medical one daily so it just didn't work out for me.
This does help keep from getting make up on my masks, but neither my husband or I found it to help with keeping our glasses from fogging up.

reviews.t: I can breathe while working out
reviews.x: This mask insert is a must when masks are required when working out.  Helps to breathe and not suck in the mask!  Great product!

reviews.t: Good product, gross if worn a long time.
reviews.x: I really like how these keep the mask cloth off of your face. It provides more room for you to actually breathe. I gave this 4 stars because it is pretty gross when your wearing it for a long period of time and it gets damp from your breathing. I feel like I need to wipe the plastic off periodically.  Overall I like the product & am thankful to be able to breathe better with a mask on. I just wish it didn’t get so damp...I don’t think there’s any way to solve that problem.

reviews.t: They're too small to work perfectly.
reviews.x: The design is good, but they are just too small. If I don't talk they stay in place, but talking causes them to move up and down on my face, and they don't return to exactly the same spot. They do keep they cloth mask off of my face and nose, but I constantly need to adjust them. If they were bigger, I believe, they would stay on my nose effectively, eliminating movement. Maybe for someone younger they would be perfect.

Honestly I just grabbed them because I needed free shipping and I work retail so I have to wear a mask to work. They’re not amazing quality but honestly you get five and I’ve been using mine for entire 9 hour shifts with no discomfort. They’re pretty functional. They’re not worth going out of your way for but having them is kinda like a luxury thing. You don’t need it but it’s pretty neat.

reviews.t: Keeps mask in place....on your face!
reviews.x: I bought this product because I was smothering in my mask and was tired of it constantly slipping up into my eyes.  Although this product does not seem to stay completely attached to the mask, it did help the mask stay in place better on my face and stay off my mouth.  I also liked that it made it easier to pull the mask down to take a drink and then replace it.

This is a nifty item that really makes it easier to breath while wearing a mask.  It stops the mask from sucking in when you talk or breath so it makes it easier for others to hear you nd also makes you feel safer since your mouth is not touching the fabric.  My son really likes this product and will be using it inside his mask when he returns to school.

I got these, but then I work from home so it's not worth it to put it on to go to the store.  So I gave them to my mom.  She gave one to a co-worker because it makes it so much easier to work all day in your mask.  She was extremely grateful for it.  I would recommend this to anyone who has to spend a significant period of time in a mask.

My wife and I use these under disposable masks for circuit training workouts. They make a huge difference during high intensity workouts. They keep the mask from drawing into your mouth when you breathe in. These are comfortable, light, and stay in place though the entire workout. We always make sure we bring these to every workout.

I got these originally.  Nothing holds it to your face or the mask,  except pressure from the mas on your face. .  So a bit awkward putting on & trying to drink while it’s on.  It does keep the mask off your face making breathing easier.  I used these for 2 weeks, till I found the soft silicone ones.  Not going back.

reviews.t: Good product but won’t fit all masks for tight seal on face
reviews.x: I like the concept of these masks but I found they did not work as well with the disposable masks I use at my job but work great with the cloth masks I use outside of work if I run out of disposable ones. It does make it easier to breathe. Would have given 5 stars if they fit more variety of masks.

reviews.t: doesnt really remain in place, even with the little tab things
reviews.x: i thought these sounded good, esp to keep my glasses from fogging.  they work OKAY.  i could not get them to stay in place with the side tabs all that well. if you leave everything alone, they stay somewhat.  i was happy to try them, but rarely if ever use them. have given 3 away.

The frame is very helpful in helping me to breathe.  I have a little trouble with just using a mask and especially talking is better because the mask isn’t going into your mouth.  Some masks are a little tight, but most work fine.  I think it will definitely be a big help.

reviews.t: Must-have if you wear a mask for long periods of time
reviews.x: This is an essential addition to face masks if you have to wear them for long amounts of time. I’m a teacher so I have to wear them 6-7 hrs a day and they get hot and stick to my face. Not with these little plastic brackets, they keep the mask from sticking to my mouth.

These mask brackets are amazing. I was so sick of my mask going in and put with my breathing and getting wet. This made my mask feel like a little tent lol. Much more pleasant to wear a mask without it sticking right to my face.

reviews.t: These do work to keep masks out/off your lips
reviews.x: These sit under the mask and keep the material away from your mouth/lips so you can breathe and talk better. Not sure if it pulls the upper mask away from the nose more to allow air in (haven't really checked).

It really serves it's purpose.  I can breathe so much better using it.  I don't use the provided clips because it doesn't fully let me open the mask .  The only drawback is that it makes my face perspire more.

This product is good but is only made for a pleated mask.  Mine is not pleated so I had to use safety pins to keep it in place. It may have said this in the description of the product but I did not read it

Does the job! More room to breathe and comfortable to wear. Just secure your mask to your ears since obviously this may put teeny tiny weight into your mask and MIGHT drag it down. It's hella light though.
I don’t love these because it feels weird in my face but it’s better than eating fabric all day. I prefer masks with a nose seam all the way down that avoids this altogether, but works if needed
I believe I would have passed out if I didn't have this to make room to breath.. It kept the mask from sucking in my mouth when I breath.  C.O.P.D. IS bad enough without a suffocating mask.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the insert keeps the mask off their mouth and makes breathing and talking easier.
Several reviewers find it uncomfortable or awkward, noting they can feel it on their face, it gets damp/steamy, or it shifts and needs adjusting.
Some reviewers say it is too small or does not fit all masks well, including disposable medical masks.
A few reviewers report it did not stop their glasses from fogging up.
Some reviewers praise it specifically for workouts and long work shifts.
